review.note: M55: the date on this relation is Wikidata’s, cited by item and property in sources — not a year read from memory, which is why it carries interval-cited rather than the seeding’s date flag.

note: The gap is inside one year: Q41304 dates the Weimar Republic’s dissolution to 1933 and no further, and Q7318 dates the Nazi state’s inception to 1933-03-15. What stood in between was the same German state, under the government that took office that winter — neither item names a third polity for those weeks, and none is invented here.
